name: Grammaropolis
description: Grammaropolis teaches grammar through a cast of characters who each are a part of speech or a punctuation mark. This connector gives Claude direct, read-only access to the Grammaropolis catalog so it can build lessons on the real concepts, characters, and Common Core standards behind the curriculum, across all five departments (Parts of Speech, the Punctuation Department, the Sentence Factory, The Writing Company, and Wonderful Words), Grades 1 through 8. It serves the full lesson body for each department's free anchor unit, 40 free lessons in all (one unit per department, every grade), and returns details plus a link for everything else. No account, no sign-in, and no student data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Grammaropolis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Grammaropolis to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.grammaropolis.com/api/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Grammaropolis MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Grammaropolis scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Grammaropolis MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grammaropolis provides these MCP tools: about_grammaropolis, find_lessons_for_standard, get_lesson, list_lessons, and list_pillars.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Grammaropolis?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Grammaropolis in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, TheWholeTorah, Fryd - Your Gardening Companion, and API Lessons.
Grammaropolis does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Grammaropolis is developed by Grammaropolis. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
